BONAFIDE.label: Bonafide certificate
BONAFIDE.hint: That the student studies here this year.

STUDY.label: Study certificate
STUDY.hint: The classes and years the student studied here — for former students too.

FEE.label: Fee paid certificate
FEE.hint: Fees paid in a financial year, tuition shown separately (income tax, section 80C).

MERIT.label: Merit / participation certificate
MERIT.hint: An achievement or event. Can be issued to many students at once.

issue.title: Issue certificates
issue.subtitle: Bonafide, character, study, fee paid and merit certificates — numbered, printed and verifiable by QR.
issue.classHint: Leave blank to use the student’s record
issue.achievementHint: Leave blank for a participation certificate
issue.remarksHint: Printed at the end of the certificate
issue.numberHint: Each certificate gets the next number (Settings › Number series) and a QR code to verify it.

preview.title: What it will say
preview.pickStudent: Pick a student to see what the certificate will say.
preview.pickStudents: Pick a class and tick the students.
preview.name: Name

register.title: Certificate register
register.subtitle: Every certificate issued.
register.search: Number, student, admission no. or purpose

cancelConfirm.title: Cancel {{no}}?
cancelConfirm.message: Anyone who scans its QR will see it as cancelled. Issue a new one if it needs correcting.

verify.cancelled: {{institution}} cancelled it on {{date}}. Don’t accept it; ask the institution for a new one.
verify.notFound: No certificate has the code {{code}}. Check the code, or contact the institution that issued it.
verify.name: Issued to
verify.compare: Compare these details with the paper you were given.

bonafide.text: This is to certify that {{name}}{{rel}}, Admission No. {{admissionNo}}, is a bonafide student of {{school}}, studying in {{cls}} during the academic year {{year}}.

print.dobLine: {{His}} date of birth as per the school records is {{dob}} ({{words}}).

character.textIs: This is to certify that {{name}}{{rel}}, Admission No. {{admissionNo}}, is a bonafide student of {{school}} since {{from}} and is at present studying in {{cls}}.
character.textWas: This is to certify that {{name}}{{rel}}, Admission No. {{admissionNo}}, was a bonafide student of {{school}} from {{from}} to {{to}}.
character.conduct: During this period {{his}} conduct and character have been found to be {{conduct}}. To the best of our knowledge {{he}} bears a good moral character and has not taken part in any activity against the discipline of the institution.
character.wish: We wish {{him}} every success in life.

study.textIs: This is to certify that {{name}}{{rel}}, Admission No. {{admissionNo}}, has been studying in {{school}} since {{from}} and is at present in {{toClass}}.
study.textWas: This is to certify that {{name}}{{rel}}, Admission No. {{admissionNo}}, studied in {{school}} from {{fromClass}} to {{toClass}} ({{from}} to {{to}}).
study.tableIntro: The classes {{he}} studied in this institution are:

fee.text: This is to certify that {{name}}{{rel}}, Admission No. {{admissionNo}}, studying in {{cls}} of {{school}}, has paid the following fees during the financial year {{fy}} ({{from}} to {{to}}):
fee.tuition: Of the above, the tuition fee paid is {{amount}} ({{words}}).
fee.head: Fee head
fee.note: Certified that the amount shown as tuition fee is the tuition fee only. It does not include development fee, donation, capitation fee, transport, hostel or any other charges. Issued for claiming deduction under section 80C of the Income-tax Act, 1961.

merit.title: Certificate
merit.wish: We congratulate {{him}} and wish {{him}} every success.

print.purpose: This certificate is issued on {{his}} request for the purpose of {{purpose}}.
